analysis: Probenecid is classified as a uricosuric drug because it increases the excretion of uric acid by inhibiting its reabsorption in the kidneys. This mechanism is distinct and well-documented in medical literature, distinguishing it from the other options which either do not increase uric acid excretion or do so as a secondary, less effective mechanism.
